reviewer: Claude Code (demo sample, not a real review)
summary: Sample critique of the original Codex build. The asymmetric editorial concept is strong and should be preserved. Problems are concentrated in mobile layout, contrast on glaze-colored backgrounds, and a broken checkout link.

strengths.title: Asymmetric editorial hero
strengths.detail: The offset product photograph and oversized serif headline give the studio a gallery feel that generic shop templates lack.

strengths.title: Slow glaze-reveal motion
strengths.detail: The 1.2s clip reveal on the hero image echoes glaze pouring. It is meaningful, not decorative.

strengths.title: Specific, warm copy
strengths.detail: Product descriptions name clay bodies and firing temperatures, which reads as the real studio voice.

findings.title: “Add to cart” links to a 404 on every product
findings.observation: All six product pages point the primary button at /cart/add, which returns 404. No purchase is possible.
findings.recommendation: Wire the button to the existing cart action in lib/cart.ts and add a success state.

findings.title: Hero headline overflows on mobile
findings.observation: At 390px the 96px headline breaks mid-word and pushes the hero image below the fold.
findings.recommendation: Use a fluid clamp() size and keep the asymmetric offset; do not center the composition.

findings.title: Body text on celadon panels fails contrast
findings.recommendation: Darken the text to the existing ink token; keep the celadon panel color.

findings.title: Kiln calendar uses placeholder dates
findings.observation: The firing calendar lists “Lorem firing” on three dates. The brief requires real seasonal dates, which were not provided.
findings.recommendation: Obtain dates from the client, or hide the section until they exist.

findings.title: Shop grid repeats identical cards
findings.observation: Twelve equal cards flatten the editorial rhythm established on the home page.
findings.recommendation: Introduce one feature tile per row using the hero’s offset grid.

findings.title: Glaze reveal ignores reduced-motion preference
findings.observation: The reveal still plays with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
findings.recommendation: Show the final frame immediately when reduced motion is requested.

findings.title: Hand-drawn section dividers
findings.observation: The brush-stroke dividers are distinctive and specific to a ceramics studio. Keep them through revisions.

missingInformation: Real kiln firing dates for the calendar.

assessment.summary: Sample assessment: a distinctive concept worth keeping. Fix the checkout blocker and the mobile hero before anything else. The layout does not need to be redesigned.
